notes.title: Demo - Small Patch! v1.02 is out.
notes.notes:
Patch v1.02 is out! This is a smaller one aimed at fixing some struggling areas.

Patch Notes -
Features -
- Reworked Sarah's Bedroom. Removing the Enemy and added a hint for the other puzzle. 
- Volume slider added to Options!
- Increased the visibility of important objects in the tutorial as well as some text giving more clear direction.

Fixes -
- Fixed a bug where you could move after attacking once whilst in attack stance
- Fixed music audio dropping after using Peeking

Still working on the bigger Controller update, but wanted to get this out sooner.

Cya soon!
